title: The Pattern Store
summary: The imperial smiths kept their patterns in the Forgehall, shelf on shelf. Tamsin wants to read how they cast what they cast. She thinks the Assay has.

steps.journal: Open two chests anywhere in the Forgehall of Oruth, on any floor. The pattern store on the first floor holds two.

ready: Two chests of the Forgehall's patterns. Show Tamsin.
done: Lamp patterns, forty to a shelf, each to hold one. Tamsin put them back very carefully.
